about_the_game:
What’s in this Demo (English):

  • 1 stage with escalating waves and 6 bosses

  • Playable character: Ébano (starter kit)

  • Core weapons + 1 evolution path available

  • Affinity preview: first dialogue tier unlocked (no romantic branches in demo)

  • Run length: ~15–20 minutes

  • Meta-progression: limited; saves carry within the demo only

How it differs from the full game:

  • Full game includes multiple stages, 6 bosses per stage, and 20+ unlockable waifus

  • Full affinity system (multi-tier bonds, weapon/skill unlocks)

  • More weapon evolutions, relics, events, and meta upgrades

  • Story beats beyond the rescue of the missing warrior

Waifu Roguelike Survivor – A unique experience of action, farming, mystery, and personal growth!
In a future devastated by forces beyond human understanding, magical warriors called Nefemances rise to challenge soul-devouring demonic entities. Your mission? Build the ultimate team, forge alliances, and survive relentless waves of increasingly dangerous enemies as you uncover clues to the apocalypse’s origin.

Exclusive highlight:
The personalities and affinity farming system were developed in collaboration with two psychiatrists and a psychologist hired specifically for this project, resulting in strikingly authentic and realistic personalities for every waifu. Each unlocked affinity is inspired by real human traits—yet every Nefemance has a unique identity.

The goal? To give players a true social experience, helping even the most hardcore gamers develop social skills, empathy, and communication—not just in-game, but in real life. Know that girl you like but never dared to talk to? Odds are, her personality is among the 20 collectible waifus in the game—and you’ll have a chance to learn how to approach, chat, and even “win over” (in a healthy, respectful way)!

Key features:

  • Frenetic survival: Intense battles with hordes of demonic creatures in a world on the brink of ruin.

  • Waifus with real personalities: Every Nefemance has a backstory, unique abilities, and legendary weapons to unlock through the affinity system.

  • Psychological affinity farming: Build deep relationships between characters, unlocking new warriors and epic weapons as you hone your own social skills.

  • Party progression: Build your squad, pick your favorites, and create synergies to push further each run.

  • Mystery and narrative: Face the Arqueessences (soul-eaters) and the Primordials, kings of the demon world, and—if you dare—discover the truth behind their existence.

  • Personal development: Learn about different personality types, practice your communication, and discover new ways to connect—all while gaming!

Will you be able to unravel the secret of this world and end the chaos? Or will you be lost among the shadows of the Primordials?

Your journey starts now. Get ready to fight, grow... and maybe discover not just the end of the world, but the start of new connections.

content_descriptors.notes:
Violence: Stylized combat against monsters and entities. No graphic gore.
Suggestive themes: Some characters wear fantasy outfits with mild suggestive elements. No nudity or sexual acts are depicted.
General: Post-apocalyptic setting, dark fantasy tone, but presented in a non-graphic style.
